{{Quote|Come on, I won't hurt you|Mander Zuma, to Matha|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
'''Matha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Scourge" /> [[Evocii]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In about [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> when Matha was still a child, he was attacked by a group of [[Vrblther/Legends|Vrblthers]] in the sub-levels of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> However, he was rescued from the creatures by the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]], the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]], and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] official [[Angela Krin]].<ref name="Scourge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Matha was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens|Owen K.C. Stevens]], and he first featured in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure. The child later appeared in [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], a novelization of the events of ''Tempest Feud'' that was written by Grubb and published in [[2012]], although he was not explicitly identified by name in the novel. In addition, while ''Tempest Feud'' established that Matha was female, the child is referred to as male in ''Scourge''.
